title: Professor of Practice
bio: Naz K. Modirzadeh is a Professor of Practice at Harvard Law School and the Founding Director of the HLS Program on International Law and Armed Conflict (PILAC). At HLS, Modirzadeh writes and teaches primarily in the field of public international law, with a focus on non-use of force, armed conflict, and counterterrorism issues. She teaches […]
